title: Vilma Santos keeps promise to Edgar Mortiz, joins concert repeat
summary: When the first “Goin’ Standard” concert of director-actor-singer Edgar “Bobot” Mortiz was staged last June, his popular loveteam partner, Batangas Governor Vilma Santos, was out of the country.
